usage: giml plan [-h] [--allow-detached] [--rewind-to COMMIT] [--dry-run]
                 [--strategy {conservative,latest}] [--scope {cve,general}]
                 [--major-updates {disallowed,allowed,ml}]
                 [--major-updates-test-scope {disallowed,allowed}] [--gate-config FILE]
                 path

positional arguments:
  path                  project directory containing pom.xml

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --allow-detached      allow a detached HEAD as the base
  --rewind-to COMMIT    start from pom.xml as it was at COMMIT (synthetic)
  --dry-run             analyse only: resolve, match CVEs, list candidates and write a report;
                        builds nothing
  --strategy {conservative,latest}
                        how far versions move (default: gate config)
  --scope {cve,general}
                        what may move: cve or general (default: gate config)
  --major-updates {disallowed,allowed,ml}
                        major updates: disallowed, allowed or ml
  --major-updates-test-scope {disallowed,allowed}
                        let major changes in test-only dependencies pass the major-update gate:
                        allowed or disallowed
  --gate-config FILE    gate config (default: giml's own)
